Group rancher2 across all modules and recipes so a provider bump lands atomically. The supported '~> 15.1' range resolves patch and minor releases on its own, so Renovate only opens a PR for a new provider major, which maps to a new Rancher minor line and fails scripts/check_rancher2_version.sh until the supported major is bumped deliberately.

RKE1 was dropped in Rancher 2.12. Hold the RKE1 modules and recipes, and the shared modules/rancher floor they depend on, below the 8.6.0 provider line: 8.5.0 is the last release with the full RKE1 resource set. See scripts/check_rancher2_version.sh.
